reviewer: Claude (Opus 5.5) review agents in the evidence-pass workflow, one per source plus one for the use-case judgements, each separate from the agent that extracted or drafted the records; finalised by a Claude (Opus 5.5) merge agent; no human review claimed.
scope: Use-case refresh for use-case-phenotype-perturbation-selection (rewire-benchmark-data #184). batch.jsonl: 1,279 new records from three sources (Edwards et al. 2026 AssayLoop, arXiv:2609.11877v1; Qin et al. 2025 NAIAD, PMLR 267; Song et al. 2025 Virtual CRISPR, BioNLP 2025) and three new relevance judgements. changes.jsonl: reviewed copies of three existing records (the use case, its baseline claim and its summary claim) applied with records -- change. Every result (866) was compared with its pinned source.

ucpheno-20261022-source-edwards2026.manual: seeded sample of 36 (seed 20261022) plus every Supplementary Table 4 block, including the 60 overflow results, against rendered pages 8 and 31, column order included

pheno-20261022-qin2025-source-pmlr.manual: rendered pages 6-8, 18 and 20 by eye, column order included; all 12 row_not_found confirmed by hand; 16 Table 3 cells recomputed as (P4-P0)/4

limitations: Automated review by Claude agents; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any result.

batch.py check-values could not place 196 of 866 results (60 AssayLoop, 12 NAIAD, 124 Virtual CRISPR) because of text-layer layout; these were covered by independent column-aware parses and by rendered-page checks.
For text layers check-values does not check the column; column assignment rests on the independent parses and the rendered-page checks.
Figures were not read: AssayLoop Figures 4 and 6 and per-screen results, NAIAD Figures 3 to 9 and drug-combination results.
Code repositories (NAIAD, Virtual CRISPR) were not read; BioBO and Probability-of-Hit papers are retrieval gaps.
Relevance judgements are reviewed decisions, not facts from a source.
corrections: AssayLoop: RF (greedy) and RF + UCB origin author_reported (was independent_paper); Random configuration no longer states the sampling universe; same_data_as link from the test subset to the AssayBench test set removed.
NAIAD: limitations added for the Table 7 / Table 4 Norman Uniform slip, Table 8 beta 0 and Uniform runs, and the TPR wording in Table 8's caption.
Virtual CRISPR: locators normalised; training release v1.1.16 and 'pooled' removed as unstated; random and embedding evaluations corrected; evidence concern added for the per-screen random baseline.
Use case: baseline claim rationale revised; summary rewritten (revision 2) with corrected handoff wording, screen-selection floor and pre-training caveat.

Finalising: records -- add rejected four attribute forms (Song ORCS training dataset version duplicated its missing reason, so omitted; AssayBench-Loop protocol heldout_test and heldout_validation made lists and uncertainty_reporting made an object); missing_metadata keys sorted in 55 records to the normaliser's form. No value, locator or link changed.
